title: Merle Nurm & Helle Niit's three titles
body: Across a season of shifting field sizes — 16 pairs in May, 12 in June, 10 in August — Merle Nurm and Helle Niit won three separate tournaments outright, more than any other pairing. No one else has more than two.

title: Marta Kask & Marko Väli, on repeat
body: No pairing has played together anywhere close to as often — 16 tournaments together, while the next-most frequent partnership managed seven. But the results never settle: six finishes 2nd or 3rd, five finishes in the bottom three, and hardly anything in between.

title: Two titles, then a crash
body: Toomas Saar & Peeter Karu won back-to-back tournaments — 10–1 on August 15, then a perfect 11–0 on August 29 — and then, the very next tournament, dropped to 10th of 14 on September 5.

title: Kadri Tamm & Liina Nõmm, straight to the title
body: Their first appearance as a pair in this dataset — September 5, the most recent tournament — and they went 10–1 across 14 pairs to win the whole thing.

title: The partner made all the difference for Jaan Vaike
body: Jaan Vaike won 45% of his games across three tournaments partnered with Signe Pärnoja, but just 14% across two tournaments partnered with Külli Küla — a 32-point swing in win rate depending only on who he was standing next to.

title: Malle Jõe & Siim Ots, dead last every time
body: In all three of their appearances together, Malle Jõe and Siim Ots finished dead last — including two tournaments with zero wins in eleven games. The only pairing with a perfect record of finishing at the bottom.
